open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

namespace BasicOpenCoverData

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

/-- The pinned-chart side containing a basic-open piece. -/
def pinnedSide (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B pi) : D.index → Bool
  | Sum.inl _ => false
  | Sum.inr _ => true

/-- The pinned-chart section cutting out a basic-open piece. -/
noncomputable def pinnedGenerator (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B pi) :
    (j : D.index) → Γ(relCurve C B, relPinnedChart C B pi (D.pinnedSide j))
  | Sum.inl j => D.h₀ j
  | Sum.inr j => D.h₁ j

theorem pieces_eq_basicOpen_pinnedGenerator
    (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B pi) (j : D.index) :
    D.pieces j = (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.pinnedGenerator j) := by
  cases j <;> rfl

end BasicOpenCoverData

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

/-- A datum component, with its open written using the uniform pinned generator. -/
noncomputable def pinnedComponent (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) :
    (j : D.index) → Γ(relCurve C B,
      (relCurve C B).basicOpen (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pinnedGenerator j))
  | Sum.inl j => D.component s (Sum.inl j)
  | Sum.inr j => D.component s (Sum.inr j)

/-- Fibrewise injectivity of multiplication by a datum component gives the ring-theoretic
nonzerodivisor condition on its pure tensor. -/
theorem component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
      ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors
          (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
  letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
  have hend : Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j) =
      LinearMap.mulLeft B (D.component s j) := by
    ext t
    simp [Scheme.mulSectionEnd_apply]
  have hinj := hfib j p
  rw [hend, rTensor_mulLeft_eq_mulLeft_tmul p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    (D.component s j)] at hinj
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    apply hinj
    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero]
    exact hz
  · intro z hz
    apply hinj
    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero, mul_comm]
    exact hz

/-- Fibrewise-regular datum components remain nonzerodivisors on their pinned basic opens
after every coefficient-ring extension. -/
theorem pinnedComponent_baseChange_mem_nonZeroDivisors [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (j : D.index) :
    relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi) B'
        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pinnedSide j)
        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pinnedGenerator j) (D.pinnedComponent s j) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors
        Γ(relCurve C B', (relCurve C B').basicOpen
          (relPinnedSectionsMap C B B' pi
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pinnedSide j)
            (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pinnedGenerator j))) := by
  cases j with
  | inl j =>
      haveI : Module.Free B
          Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀) :=
        free_relSections C B (fiberChart₀ pi)
          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen pi 0).isCompact
          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen pi 0).isQuasiSeparated
      letI : Module.Flat B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (Sum.inl j)) := by
        rw [D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_inl]
        exact flat_sections_basicOpen B
          (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover pi)) Module.Flat.of_free (D.h₀ j)
      have hbase :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_tmul_residueField
          (fun p => D.component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors s hfib (Sum.inl j) p) B'
      have hpulled := map_mem_nonZeroDivisors'
        (relPinnedPieceBaseChange (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' false (D.h₀ j)).toRingEquiv hbase
      change relPinnedPieceBaseChange (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' false (D.h₀ j) ((1 : B') ⊗ₜ[B] D.component s (Sum.inl j)) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors _ at hpulled
      rw [relPinnedPieceBaseChange_one_tmul] at hpulled
      change relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' false (D.h₀ j) (D.component s (Sum.inl j)) ∈ nonZeroDivisors _
      exact hpulled
  | inr j =>
      haveI : Module.Free B
          Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁) :=
        free_relSections C B (fiberChart₁ pi)
          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen pi 1).isCompact
          (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen pi 1).isQuasiSeparated
      letI : Module.Flat B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (Sum.inr j)) := by
        rw [D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_inr]
        exact flat_sections_basicOpen B
          (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover pi)) Module.Flat.of_free (D.h₁ j)
      have hbase :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_tmul_residueField
          (fun p => D.component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors s hfib (Sum.inr j) p) B'
      have hpulled := map_mem_nonZeroDivisors'
        (relPinnedPieceBaseChange (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' true (D.h₁ j)).toRingEquiv hbase
      change relPinnedPieceBaseChange (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' true (D.h₁ j) ((1 : B') ⊗ₜ[B] D.component s (Sum.inr j)) ∈
        nonZeroDivisors _ at hpulled
      rw [relPinnedPieceBaseChange_one_tmul] at hpulled
      change relPinnedPieceSectionsMap (C := C) (R := B) (pi := pi)
          B' true (D.h₁ j) (D.component s (Sum.inr j)) ∈ nonZeroDivisors _
      exact hpulled

end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

end AlgebraicGeometry

namespace AffAdaptation

variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
variable (A : AffAdaptation D d)

/-- The pulled piece equation IS the section the fibre-curve reading of `hfib` speaks about.
Definitional, recorded because it is the seam between the two files. -/
lemma pulledEqn_eq_relAffSectionsMap {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R']
    [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R'] (j : D.index) :
    A.pulledEqn R' j = relAffSectionsMap C R' (D.pieces j) (A.eqn j) := rfl

/-- **Obligation 4(i) in the assembler's own shape, from self-regularity on the fibre.**  The
tensor condition `eqn j ⊗ 1 ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Γ(pieces j) ⊗[R] κ(p))` holds as soon as the
pulled SYSTEM equation is regular at its own point on the fibre curve over `κ(p)`. -/
theorem eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_self_pullbackEqn (j : D.index)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hreg : ∀ z : relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
      ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).presheaf.germ
        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField)).opens z) z
        ((d.cover.pullback
          (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField)).mem_opens z)).hom
        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
          (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField) d z) ∈
          nonZeroDivisors
            ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).presheaf.stalk z)) :
    (A.eqn j ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
  refine (A.eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff j p).mpr ?_
  have h := A.pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_self_pullbackEqn
    (R' := p.asIdeal.ResidueField) hreg j
  rwa [A.pulledEqn_eq_relAffSectionsMap (R' := p.asIdeal.ResidueField) j] at h

end AffAdaptation

/-- **The pulled-equation germ of a composite is the germ of the two-stage pullback**
at the point's own member: the equations agree after restriction to the two-stage
member (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE`), and germs are restriction-invariant. -/
theorem germ_pullbackEqn_comp {Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : Y ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {h : Z ⟶ X}
    (hgf : g ≫ f = h) (E : X.LocalEquations) (hregf) (ζ : Z) :
    (Z.presheaf.germ ((E.cover.pullback h).opens ζ) ζ
        ((E.cover.pullback h).mem_opens ζ)).hom (pullbackEqn h E ζ)
      = (Z.presheaf.germ (((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).opens ζ) ζ
          (((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).mem_opens ζ)).hom
          (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ) := by
  subst hgf
  have hcov : ((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ ≤
      (E.cover.pullback (g ≫ f)).opens ζ :=
    le_of_eq (by
      rw [Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens,
        Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
        Scheme.Hom.comp_apply])
  -- the section-level collapse on the two-stage member (the `divEq_pullback_pullback`
  -- calc)
  have h2 := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE g f
    (E.cover.opens (f.base (g.base ζ))) ((E.cover.pullback f).opens (g.base ζ))
    (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ) le_rfl le_rfl)).hom
      (E.eqn (f.base (g.base ζ))))
  have hsec : (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl
      (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ))).op).hom
      (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ)
      = (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hcov).op).hom (pullbackEqn (g ≫ f) E ζ) :=
    (pullbackEqn_res g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ le_rfl).trans
      (h2.trans (pullbackEqn_res (g ≫ f) E ζ hcov).symm)
  have hg₁ := Z.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hcov) ζ
    (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).mem_opens ζ) (pullbackEqn (g ≫ f) E ζ)
  have hg₂ := Z.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (le_refl
      (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ))) ζ
    (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).mem_opens ζ)
    (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ)
  calc (Z.presheaf.germ ((E.cover.pullback (g ≫ f)).opens ζ) ζ
        ((E.cover.pullback (g ≫ f)).mem_opens ζ)).hom (pullbackEqn (g ≫ f) E ζ)
      = (Z.presheaf.germ (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ) ζ
          (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).mem_opens ζ)).hom
          ((Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hcov).op).hom (pullbackEqn (g ≫ f) E ζ)) :=
        hg₁.symm
    _ = (Z.presheaf.germ (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens ζ) ζ
          (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).mem_opens ζ)).hom
          ((Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl _)).op).hom
            (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ)) := by rw [hsec]
    _ = (Z.presheaf.germ (((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).opens ζ) ζ
          (((E.pullback f hregf).cover.pullback g).mem_opens ζ)).hom
          (pullbackEqn g (E.pullback f hregf) ζ) := hg₂

lemma exists_mem_pieces (x : relCurve C B) : ∃ j : D.index, x ∈ D.pieces j := by
  have hx : x ∈ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊔ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
    rw [relCover_sup]
    trivial
  rcases (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup).mp hx with h0 | h1
  · have hcov := D.cover₀ h0
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
    exact ⟨Sum.inl j, hj⟩
  · have hcov := D.cover₁ h1
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
    exact ⟨Sum.inr j, hj⟩

/-- A choice of piece through every point of the relative curve. -/
noncomputable def pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : D.index :=
  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose

lemma mem_pieces_pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : x ∈ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose_spec

/-- **The canonical pointed cover by pieces** of the datum. -/
noncomputable def pointedCover : (relCurve C B).PointedCover where
  opens x := D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x)
  mem_opens x := D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x

@[simp]
lemma pointedCover_opens (x : relCurve C B) :
    D.pointedCover.opens x = D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) := rfl

/-- **The Čech Picard class of the pinned cocycle datum** (stage 1e): the class of the
subordinated unit cocycle on the canonical pointed cover by pieces. By
`cechPicClass_eq_mk` it is computed by **any** pointed cover subordinated to the
pieces. -/
noncomputable def cechPicClass : (relCurve C B).CechPic :=
  Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover

    13	
    14	This module is the R2 bridge used by admissible Abel coverage.  A section of a cocycle datum
    15	first cuts intrinsic local equations.  Fibrewise regularity is transported through the section
    16	ring of an arbitrary affine open; the resulting local-equation system is then certified using

    18	of the two auxiliary charts used to present the cocycle.

    46	theorem component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    47	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
    48	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    49	    (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    50	    letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    51	      ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    52	    (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    53	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
    54	        nonZeroDivisors
    55	          (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    56	  letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    57	    ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    58	  have hend : Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j) =
    59	      LinearMap.mulLeft B (D.component s j) := by

    61	    simp [Scheme.mulSectionEnd_apply]
    62	  have hinj := hfib j p
    63	  rw [hend, rTensor_mulLeft_eq_mulLeft_tmul p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    64	    (D.component s j)] at hinj
    65	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
    66	  constructor
    67	  · intro z hz
    68	    apply hinj
    69	    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero]
    70	    exact hz
    71	  · intro z hz
    72	    apply hinj
    73	    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero, mul_comm]
    74	    exact hz

     8	/-!
     9	# Application formulas for the admissible widened Abel map
    10	
    11	This file isolates the map-level equalities needed after a widened divisor family has been
    12	constructed on an affine test. It exposes the chart datum chosen inside the admissible map,
    13	computes a represented point under the Sigma-extended Abel transformation, identifies the
    14	affine Abel value after the vehicle collapse, and packages the final cancellation of the
    15	fixed chart twists.
    16	
    17	No quotient, atlas, or representability conclusion is asserted here.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    32	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    33	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    34	
    35	noncomputable section
    36	
    37	variable (C) in
    38	/-- The chart index and divisor chosen inside the admissible Abel map can be exposed without
    39	choosing new data. The equality is definitional after unfolding the admissible map. -/
    40	theorem exists_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible_eq :
    41	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    42	      (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    43	        = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
    44	          - (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C : ℤ)),
    45	      abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C =
    46	        abelSigmaChartAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
    47	          (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) m Z hdeg := by
    48	  dsimp only [abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible]
    49	  exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
    50	
    51	variable {n : ℕ}
    52	
    53	/-- Classifying a section with a representer and then evaluating the Sigma-extended Abel map
    54	at the underlying scheme morphism returns the original section's chart value. The equality of
    55	the two structure morphisms is handled by sigma-extension extensionality. -/
    56	theorem abelSigmaChartAff_app_homEquiv_symm
    57	    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    58	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D)
    59	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    60	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    61	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    62	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    63	    (s : divFamZarAff C n (Over.mk a)) :
    64	    let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    65	    (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    66	      (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    67	        (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) := by
    68	  let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    69	  change (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    70	    (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    71	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y))
    72	  change (⟨q.left ≫ D.hom, _⟩ :
    73	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) =
    74	    ⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩
    75	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext (pic0TypeFunctor C) q.w ?_
    76	  let e := Over.mkCongr q.w
    77	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom) ⟶ D :=
    78	    Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom)) q.left
    79	  change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
    80	      ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s) =
    81	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    82	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) (rep.homEquiv q')
    83	  have hhom : e ≫ q = q' := by
    84	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    85	    exact Category.id_comp _
    86	  have hq : rep.homEquiv q = s := by
    87	    dsimp only [q]
    88	    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply rep.homEquiv s
    89	  have hfamily : rep.homEquiv q' =
    90	      (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := by
    91	    calc
    92	      rep.homEquiv q' = rep.homEquiv (e ≫ q) := congrArg rep.homEquiv hhom.symm
    93	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op (rep.homEquiv q) := rep.homEquiv_comp e q
    94	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := congrArg _ hq
    95	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    96	    ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).naturality e.op) s
    97	  calc
    98	    _ = (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    99	        (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) ((divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s) := by
   100	      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
   101	    _ = _ := congrArg _ hfamily.symm

   104	/-- On an affine test, passing a widened affine family through the inverse vehicle comparison
   105	and then taking its Abel value recovers the direct affine Abel value. -/
   106	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'_affineEquiv_symm
   107	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
   108	    picEtAffineEquiv C A
   109	        (abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k A) ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n A).symm F))
   110	      = abelDivAffPlus C A F := by
   111	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff', Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   112	
   113	/-- If the Abel value of a widened family is the inverse chart twist of a target degree-zero
   114	class, then the chart transformation sends that family to the target itself. -/
   115	theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
   116	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   117	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   118	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   119	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   120	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   121	    (habel : abelDivAff' C n T s = chartTwist C m Z T lam.1) :
   122	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op T) s = lam := by
   123	  apply Subtype.ext
   124	  rw [chartValueAffTrans_app_coe]
   125	  change chartValueAff C n m Z T s = lam.1
   126	  rw [chartValueAff, habel, chartTwist]
   127	  group
   128	
   129	end

   131	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Etale-site reduction and affine PicEt honestification
    11	
    12	This file provides the site-theoretic and affine-plus infrastructure used to turn affine
    13	local lifts into local surjectivity on the big etale site. It also packages the passage from
    14	an affine `picEt` class to an honest relative Picard class after restriction to the carrier of
    15	one of its etale presentations.
    16	
    17	The declarations here are independent of the Abel transformation and make no representability
    18	or quotient assertion.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-! ## Reduction to affine tests -/
    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i
    67	
    68	/-! ## Covers induced by affine etale presentations -/
    69	
    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of
    71	the spectrum of the base algebra. -/
    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    83	
    84	/-! ## Honestification of affine PicEt classes -/
    85	
    86	namespace PicEtAff
    87	
    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   116	
   117	end PicEtAff
   118	
   119	/-- On affine tests, restricting a `picEt` class to the carrier of one of its plus
   120	presentations agrees with the `picEt` unit of the corresponding honest relative Picard
   121	class. -/
   122	theorem picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   125	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   126	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   127	    (x : descentClasses C E)
   128	    (h : picEtAffineEquiv C A lam = PicEtAff.mk C E x) :
   129	    picEtMap C
   130	        (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) lam
   131	      = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   132	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   133	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C E.Carrier).injective
   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,
   135	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
   136	    PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   137	
   138	end
   139	
   140	end AlgebraicGeometry

    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i

    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of

    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)

    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)

   114	class, then the chart transformation sends that family to the target itself. -/
   115	theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
   116	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   117	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   118	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   119	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZarAff C n T)

   124	  rw [chartValueAffTrans_app_coe]

     8	/-!
     9	# DAT-B B-5: the coverage obligation is Zariski-local in the test, so AFFINE tests suffice
    10	
    11	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean` reduced `ChartsCoverLocally` — and with it
    12	antecedent 2 of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` — to pointwise data at **every test scheme
    13	`T`**.  That is where the reduction chain stops, and the quantifier it stops at is the
    14	problem this file addresses.
    15	
    16	**Every divisor-side producer in this project is indexed by a RING, not by a scheme.**
    17	`DivFamZar C S π n` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean:235`) is a quotient of local-equation
    18	systems over an algebra `S`; `divFamZar C π n T` at a general test
    19	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean:187`) is the affine-opens *limit* of those, and the
    20	comparison `divFamZarAffineEquiv` (:300) collapses it to `DivFamZar` only on an affine
    21	test.  Likewise every producer of a certified family, of an effective witness
    22	(`DivisorFamilyFieldSurj.lean:147`), and every classifier
    23	(`effectiveDivisorClassifyZar`, :217) is stated over a ring or a field.  So a coverage
    24	lane facing "for every scheme `T`" has to cross the affine-to-general gap **before** it can
    25	use any of that machinery, and nothing said it was allowed to skip it.
    26	
    27	It is allowed to skip it, and that is this file's content.
    28	
    29	## Why locality in the test is not bookkeeping the producer can inline
    30	
    31	The naive argument — "sieves are local, so restrict to an affine cover" — is not available
    32	as stated, because `ChartsCoverLocally` is a statement about the sieve on `T` itself, and
    33	the pointwise hypothesis quantifies over points of `T`.  Three things have to be checked,
    34	and each is where the argument could fail:
    35	
    36	* **the class must restrict.**  The datum at a point `t` of an affine piece `Y` is about a
    37	  section over an open of `Y`, while the obligation at `t : ↥T` is about an open of `T`.
    38	  Composing `W.ι ≫ 𝒰.f j` gives a map into `T` but not an *open of* `T`, so the transport
    39	  cannot be done at the level of `T.Opens` — it has to be done at the level of the sieve,
    40	  where an arbitrary morphism is allowed;
    41	* **the sieve must be transitive.**  Membership of `⨆ i, imageSieve (f i) s` in the
    42	  topology on `T` is deduced from membership of its *pullbacks* along the cover maps, which
    43	  is `GrothendieckTopology.transitive` plus `Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve` — the latter is
    44	  what says the pullback of an image sieve is the image sieve of the restricted section,
    45	  i.e. that the obligation at `Y` is about `s|_Y` and nothing else;
    46	* **the pullback must commute with the supremum.**  `Sieve.pullback` is a left adjoint on
    47	  sieves, so it preserves `iSup`; without that the per-piece obligations would be about a
    48	  different sieve than the one the pullback of the target names.
    49	
    50	None of the three mentions `pic⁰`, a chart, or a divisor.  That is the point: the
    51	affine-to-general passage for antecedent 2 is a fact about the site, and mixing it with the
    52	geometry is what made it look like part of the geometry's price.
    53	
    54	## What this does and does not buy
    55	
    56	It buys the quantifier, and only the quantifier.  `chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal` below
    57	asks for the pointwise datum **only over affine schemes**, and produces
    58	`ChartsCoverLocally` at every test; `isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_affine` composes that
    59	with B-6.  So a producer may now assume its test is `Spec S` and reach for
    60	`divFamZarAffineEquiv`, `DivisorFamilyFieldSurj`, `effectiveDivisorClassifyZar` and the rest
    61	of the ring-indexed machinery directly.
    62	
    63	It does **not** produce the datum at an affine test.  That is B-5's geometry and it remains
    64	open; per `Picard/Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean` and the `dat-b` row the residue there is
    65	the class-side question, and per `Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean` the range containment `hV` is
    66	a further separate obligation.  What changes is that the residue is now stated where the
    67	tree's producers live.
    68	
    69	**On the converse, corrected.**  An earlier version of this paragraph said
    70	`affineLocal_of_chartsCoverLocally` makes the affine and general forms "equivalent", and cited
    71	that as discharging the `reduction-needs-its-converse` safeguard.  It does not: that
    72	declaration is `rfl`-equal to `pointwise_of_chartsCoverLocally`, its `[IsAffine Y]` binder is
    73	never used, and the direction it certifies is the *free* one — general pointwise data gives the
    74	affine data by `fun Y _ s y => h Y s y`.  So the affine form is a genuine **weakening** of the
    75	general one, which is exactly why `chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal` is worth having; the
    76	honest certificate is that theorem, not a no-op converse (audit `I-1023`).  The converse is
    77	kept only as the affine-test instance of the pointwise extraction, which is what it is.
    78	
    79	**On the atlas, and this is the sharper limit.**  Nothing here pins `V`.  The statements below
    80	take an arbitrary family `f`, which is what makes the site content reusable — but a consumer
    81	must supply coverage at the *same* `V` at which antecedent 1 was certified, and `ajcr-p1`
    82	measured both ends of that range to be bad: `hf` is free at `V = ⊥` (`isChartUniv_bot`, with a
    83	construction that never mentions the Abel chart), while `V = ⊤` returns the unrestricted
    84	certificate that three headers call false.  So any workable `V` is a proper intermediate open,
    85	CHART-U(b)'s openness is load-bearing, and the pair `(huniv V, hcov V)` has **no measured
    86	inhabitant at any `V`** (`I-1012`).  Two bad endpoints are two refutations, not a non-vacuity
    87	check.
    88	
    89	## Main declarations
    90	
    91	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_zariskiTopology_of_pullback_affine` — **the site fact**, with no
    92	  presheaf and no chart: a sieve on `T` is covering as soon as its pullback along every map
    93	  from an affine scheme in a cover of `T` is covering.
    94	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal` — **the reduction**: pointwise
    95	  coverage over affine tests only gives `ChartsCoverLocally` at every test.
    96	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_affine` — the composite with B-6, i.e.
    97	  the instance `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes, from affine-test data alone.
    98	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineLocal_of_chartsCoverLocally` — the converse, so the affine form
    99	  is not a strengthening.
   100	-/

   102	set_option autoImplicit false
   103	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
   104	
   105	universe u
   106	
   107	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
   108	
   109	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
   110	
   111	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   112	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   113	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   114	
   115	noncomputable section
   116	
   117	/-! ## The site fact -/
   118	
   119	/-- **A sieve is covering as soon as it is covering after pullback to affine pieces.**
   120	
   121	Stated for an arbitrary sieve on an arbitrary scheme, because that is all it uses.  The
   122	cover is `Scheme.affineCover`, whose members are affine by
   123	`Scheme.isAffine_affineCover`, and the deduction is `GrothendieckTopology.transitive`
   124	against the presieve the cover generates.
   125	
   126	This is the step the coverage chain was missing: it says the Zariski-local-surjectivity
   127	obligation may be discharged one affine piece of the test at a time. -/
   128	theorem mem_zariskiTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
   129	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
   130	      Scheme.zariskiTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
   131	    S ∈ Scheme.zariskiTopology T := by
   132	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
   133	      ∈ Scheme.zariskiTopology T :=
   134	    Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
   135	  refine Scheme.zariskiTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
   136	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
   137	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
   138	  exact Scheme.zariskiTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
   139	
   140	/-! ## The reduction -/
   141	
   142	variable (C) in
   143	/-- **THE AFFINE-TEST REDUCTION**: pointwise coverage over affine tests gives
   144	`ChartsCoverLocally` at every test.
   145	
   146	The hypothesis is `chartsCoverLocally_of_pointwise`'s, with `[IsAffine Y]` added and
   147	nothing else changed.  So a coverage producer may assume its test is affine — hence, through
   148	`divFamZarAffineEquiv`, that its divisor data lives over a *ring*, which is where every
   149	producer in this project is stated. -/
   150	theorem chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   151	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   152	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (y : ↥Y),
   153	      ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ W) (i : ι) (x : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X i),
   154	        (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s) :
   155	    ChartsCoverLocally C f := by
   156	  intro T s
   157	  refine mem_zariskiTopology_of_pullback_affine _ fun j => ?_
   158	  -- the pullback of the supremum is the supremum of the pullbacks, and each is the image
   159	  -- sieve of the RESTRICTED section — so the obligation at the affine piece is exactly the
   160	  -- affine instance of the hypothesis
   161	  have hpb : (⨆ i, Presheaf.imageSieve (f i) s).pullback (T.affineCover.f j)
   162	      = ⨆ i, Presheaf.imageSieve (f i)
   163	          ((pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (T.affineCover.f j).op s) := by
   164	    -- `Sieve.pullback` preserves `iSup` (it is a left adjoint), and per index it turns the
   165	    -- image sieve of `s` into that of `s` restricted along the cover map
   166	    simp only [← Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
   167	    ext Y g
   168	    simp only [iSup, Sieve.sSup_apply, Sieve.pullback_apply]
   169	    aesop
   170	  rw [hpb]
   171	  -- the piece is affine (`Scheme.isAffine_affineCover`), so the hypothesis applies AT IT — note
   172	  -- `chartsCoverLocally_of_pointwise` cannot be cited here, since it quantifies over all tests
   173	  -- and would demand the datum at the non-affine ones too; the site bridge is what is reused
   174	  choose W hW i x hx using h (T.affineCover.X j)
   175	    ((pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (T.affineCover.f j).op s)
   176	  exact mem_zariskiTopology_iSup_of_pointwise _ W hW i fun y => ⟨x y, hx y⟩
   177	
   178	variable (C) in
   179	/-- **B-5 over affine tests ⟹ B-6**: the local-surjectivity instance
   180	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes, from affine-test coverage data alone. -/
   181	theorem isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_affine {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   182	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   183	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) (y : ↥Y),
   184	      ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (_ : y ∈ W) (i : ι) (x : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X i),
   185	        (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op s) :
   186	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   187	  isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc f (chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal C f h)
   188	
   189	/-! ## The converse -/
   190	
   191	variable (C) in
   192	/-- **The affine form is not a strengthening**: `ChartsCoverLocally` gives back, over each
   193	affine test, a cover on whose members some chart hits the section.
   194	
   195	Read the carrier honestly, exactly as `pointwise_of_chartsCoverLocally` does: the sieve
   196	condition returns a cover by *arbitrary* schemes with open-immersion maps, not by opens of
   197	the test, so the converse produces a cover map where the hypothesis consumed an opens
   198	inclusion.  For the purpose this serves — that the affine-only hypothesis is available, not
   199	chosen for provability — a cover map is exactly as good. -/
   200	theorem affineLocal_of_chartsCoverLocally {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   201	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   202	    (h : ChartsCoverLocally C f) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y]
   203	    (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) :
   204	    ∃ (𝒰 : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @IsOpenImmersion)),
   205	      ∀ j : 𝒰.I₀, ∃ (i : ι) (x : 𝒰.X j ⟶ X i),
   206	        (f i).app (op (𝒰.X j)) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (𝒰.f j).op s :=
   207	  pointwise_of_chartsCoverLocally C f h Y s
   208	
   209	end
   210	
   211	end AlgebraicGeometry

130	
   131	Compare `exists_splitting_of_picEt` (`Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`): that gives a *field*
   132	extension and requires the base to be a field; this gives an étale extension and requires
   133	nothing.  The two are the field and general-base halves of the same move, and the chart layer
   134	needs both — the field one to read the split witness predicate at a point, this one to run the
   135	engine over a base. -/
   136	theorem exists_honest_of_picEtAff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   137	    (a : PicEtAff C A) :
   138	    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra k B) (_ : Algebra A B)
   139	        (_ : IsScalarTower k A B) (z : relPic C (overSpec k B)),
   140	      PicEtAff.map C B a = PicEtAff.unit C B z := by
   141	  induction a using PicEtAff.ind with
   142	  | mk E x =>
   143	    refine ⟨E.Carrier, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
   144	      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)), ?_⟩
   145	    exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   146	
   147	/-! ## The payoff: the engine's input, with honesty discharged -/
   148	
   149	variable (C π) in
   150	/-- **The engine input, assembled**: for any plus class over any affine base `A` and any chart
   151	index `(m, Z)`, once the class is read honestly over a base `B` above `A` by a Čech class `c`,
   152	a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `B` presenting `c` twisted by the chart index exists.
   153	
   154	This composes the two halves that were previously recorded as separate gates:
   155	
   156	* honesty over `B := E.Carrier` — `exists_honest_of_picEtAff` above, which needs no field;
   157	* presentation of the twisted class by a datum — `exists_cechPicClass_eq`, applied at the
   158	  *product* class, which is why no `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.mul` is needed
   159	  (`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean`).
   160	
   161	The conclusion is exactly the input of
   162	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`, so the openness of the witness
   163	locus over `Spec B` is available for every plus class and every chart index.  What is *not* here
   164	is the identification of that locus with `chartLocus` — that is `IsChartDatumPresentation`, the
   165	one genuine remaining obligation of CHART-U(b).
   166	
   167	Stated with `c` as a hypothesis rather than bundled into the existential: bundling it forces the
   168	elaborator to unify the tower instances on `B` while `B` is still a metavariable, which is the
   169	hazard recorded at `Picard/Pic0ChartSplit.lean`'s closing note.  A consumer obtains `B` and `c`
   170	from `exists_honest_of_picEtAff` plus `relPicMk_surjective`, then applies this. -/
   171	theorem exists_datum_cechPicClass_twist {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   172	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic) (m : ℕ)
   173	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
   174	    ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
   175	      D.cechPicClass
   176	        = c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z) :=
   177	  exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass c m Z
   178	
   179	end
   180	
   181	end AlgebraicGeometry
   190	/-! ## Presentation needs no GAP-1 mul
   191	
   192	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq` is a **surjectivity** statement: every Čech
   193	class over an affine base is the class of some datum.  So the datum the openness route needs
   194	is obtained by extraction *at the product class*, not by multiplying data.  The two lemmas
   195	below are one line each; they exist to make the point unmissable at the place a lane will
   196	look for it. -/
   197	
   198	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   199	/-- **Extraction already presents any product or inverse of classes** — the general form.
   200	
   201	This is the direct refutation of "there is no `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.mul`, so a datum for a
   202	product has no route".  A datum for the product exists; what does not exist is a
   203	*construction of it from the factors' data*, which is a different (and unneeded) statement. -/
   204	theorem exists_datum_cechPicClass_mul_inv {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   205	    (c c' : (relCurve C B).CechPic) :
   206	    ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π, D.cechPicClass = c * c'⁻¹ :=
   207	  BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq _
   208	
   209	/-- **A presenting datum for the collapsed twist class exists**, over any affine base and for
   210	any chart index — with no GAP-1 mul, no `invDatum`, and no `cechPicClass_inv`.
   211	
   212	`c` here is the honest Čech class of the plus class being tested (over the étale carrier,
   213	supplied by the collapse of `w4-datb` §1.2 step 1, i.e. `Pic0ChartSplit`), and the twist
   214	class is base-changed into `relCurve C B` along `relCurveMap`.  The conclusion is precisely
   215	the input of `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`. -/
   216	theorem exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   217	    (c : (relCurve C B).CechPic) (m : ℕ)
   218	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) :
   219	    ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π,
   220	      D.cechPicClass
   221	        = c * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k B) (chartTwistClass C m Z) :=
   222	  BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq _
   223	
   224	end
   225	
   226	end AlgebraicGeometry
